semantics.operation_rule: Activation explicitly names runtime instance and accepted snapshot.
semantics.load_rule: Runtime loads only the target snapshot's canonical state plus explicit instance/runtime configuration.
semantics.validation_rule: Runtime-specific validation occurs before commit to active state.
semantics.failure_rule: Activation failure leaves previous active snapshot intact where transactional activation is supported.
semantics.authority_rule: Activation operation itself is governed by AccessCore when AC is active.
semantics.repository_rule: Activation never changes repository acceptance state.

invariants.rule: Repository acceptance establishes canonical source state; runtime activation/reload is a separate explicit lifecycle operation over an exact accepted snapshot.

hard_gates.condition: activation implicitly changes repository accepted state
failed activation leaves ambiguous mixed state
